Definition: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself):--habitation.
BiblicalUsage: Katoikia means a habitation, the place where people dwell. Acts 17:26 says God made all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and determined the bounds of their habitation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God set every nation's borders himself, so no people is an accident and none is outside his reach.
